policies.title: Russian ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina visa-free short visit
policies.summary: The current Russian MFA passport-type table records visa-free travel for an ordinary Russian passport to Bosnia and Herzegovina for up to 30 days in 60 days.
conditions: The ordinary-passport table states 'без визы до 30 дней в течение 60 дней' (visa-free up to 30 days in 60 days).
This does not normalize residence, work, transit, special passports, document requirements, individual admission decisions or any separate Bosnia and Herzegovina entry conditions.

policies.title: Russian ordinary passports: Cuba visa-free short visit
policies.summary: The current Russian MFA passport-type table records visa-free travel for an ordinary Russian passport to Cuba for up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: The ordinary-passport table states 'без визы до 90 суток в течение 180 дней' (visa-free up to 90 days in 180 days).
This does not alter the existing canonical Cuba-to-Russia policy; it records the outbound Russian-passport relation only and excludes longer stays, work, residence, documents and final admission.

policies.title: Russian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visit
policies.summary: The current Russian MFA passport-type table records visa-free travel for an ordinary Russian passport to Panama for up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: The ordinary-passport table states 'без визы до 90 дней в течение 180 дней' (visa-free up to 90 days in 180 days).
This does not normalize residence, work, transit, special passports, document requirements, individual admission decisions or Panama's separate entry conditions.

policies.title: Russian ordinary passports: Tunisia visa-free short visit
policies.summary: The current Russian MFA passport-type table records unilateral visa-free travel for an ordinary Russian passport to Tunisia for up to 90 days.
conditions: The ordinary-passport table states 'без визы до 90 дней' (visa-free up to 90 days) and notes that this is unilateral.
This does not establish treatment for tour-package, residence, work, transit, special-document, document, carrier or final-admission conditions.
